ValidationRule.description: Creation is always allowed. Edits are allowed while the record is still new (isFirstUpdate__c = false), or once isFirstUpdate__c = true only while isDepartmentChanged__c = false. The edit is blocked only when both isFirstUpdate__c and isDepartmentChange
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity can't be edited right now. Edits are only allowed while the record is new, or after the department is not changed.
